facts.activity_file: responding to a reagent splash or release

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: restraint and placarding of transported loads
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: fire on P-8303 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the restraint and placarding of transported loads on P-8303, M-8303 and PT-8303 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically responding to a reagent splash or release. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 14 April 2026 an incident occurred on P-8303, M-8303 and PT-8303 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
